thread:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: multiple PagerDuty delivery failures observed across EU and US regions. ~120s median delay, ~30% ack not delivered to SMS. PD incident link: https://status.pagerduty.com/ (confirm)
alex.chang: I’m oncall. Seeing pages for db-replicator and api-gateway, but PD shows some events as "undelivered". Can people with PD access confirm?
 nina_k: Confirmed. PD UI shows a spike in 'delivery' errors starting 22:07 UTC. Their status page has 'Investigating - Notifications'.
 sam+oncall: I'm not getting SMS/push for high-sev. Slack integrations still posting webhooks to #alerts but with ~2m lag.
 pagerduty-bot: System Note: Failed deliveries to +1-415-***-**** (SMS) x14 in last 10m. Error: 502 from notification-delivery-service.
 alex.chang: Ok. Immediate mitigation: 1) switch critical alerting to Slack webhook (low latency but noise), 2) enable email fallback for Critical, 3) create manual phone tree for Pagerduty warm-call if needed.
 ops-lead: Agree. Sam, can you flip the alerting route for services with customer impact? Prioritize: payments, auth, hosted-api.
 sam+oncall: Doing now. Command I use: ``/pd service-rule update --service payments --route slack-webhook-critical`` (pseudo). Will post exact change.
 nina_k: Adding temporary runbook steps in incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/incidents/1768509001 (draft). People, add what you change so we can revert post-incident.
 alex.chang: Quick customer-impact check: Metrics show a rise in 5xx on hosted inference frontend starting 22:06 UTC, error budget alerts firing. Could be correlated to downstream PD noise? Or PD is independent.
 sam+oncall: After switching payments + auth to Slack webhooks: test alert fired at 22:14 and delivered within 8s. Logging shows webhook 2xx.
 pagerduty-bot: Note: Events that were previously undelivered are queued; manual retry recommended.
 alex.chang: Nina, please notify key customers in-app and via email about potential delayed on-call responses. Prior message: "We are investigating third-party alert delivery issues affecting on-call paging; engineers are monitoring." Keep it short.
 nina_k: Notifying customers now. CC Ops SRE and Support.
 sam+oncall: PD support ticket opened: https://support.pagerduty.com/ticket/12345 — PD assigned engineer, ETA 30m. Logged error snippets: ``notification-delivery-service returning 502 / connection reset``.
 alex.chang: Handoff plan: I’ll be on this for another 30m. If PD still degraded at 23:00 UTC, hand off to @ops-lead. Leave a comment in thread when you take over.
 oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff reminder scheduled at 23:00 UTC.
 ops-lead: I'll be ready to take over. Please include summary + actions in the thread and confirm which services were re-routed.
 alex.chang: Summary so far: - Root cause unknown (PD delivery errors). - Mitigations: re-routed payments + auth + hosted-api critical alerts to Slack webhooks and email; manual phone tree standing by. - Customer comms: initial notice sent. - PD ticket open. - Observability: increased 5xx on hosted inference frontend; investigating if separate cause.
 sam+oncall: Added quick script to replay critical incidents to oncall via Slack for testing: ``scripts/replay_alerts.sh --target slack --filter critical``. Ran replay; delivery confirmed.
 nina_k: Support reports one customer with delayed incident response (enterprise-acct-44). Logged as P0 customer impact; CS contacting.
 alex.chang: Action items: 1) Keep PD fallback active until PD resolves. 2) Create temporary escalation path doc. 3) Post-incident: audit all services' notification routing and add automated failover tests.
 pagerduty-bot: Update: Their status page updated to "Identified - Notifications" at 22:36 UTC. Root cause: a regional delivery queue regression.
 alex.chang: Good. Let's keep mitigations for another 30m after their fix. Ops-lead, if you take over, confirm reversion steps: slack -> pd route switch and verify via test replay.
 ops-lead: Taking over at 23:00 UTC. Will run verification steps and coordinate reversion.
 oncall-rotation-bot: Handoff: alex.chang -> ops-lead at 23:00 UTC.
 ops-lead: Verified PD notifications showing green at 23:08 UTC. Ran replay: PD push + SMS delivered within 20s. Initiating reversion for payments, auth, hosted-api to primary PD routes.
 sam+oncall: Reversion done for payments + auth. Test alert delivered to PD and SMS.
 nina_k: Closing customer comms loop: Support confirmed enterprise-acct-44 acknowledged updates; no data loss.
 alex.chang: Wrapping up. Will file postmortem draft and include timeline + decision to failover to Slack and email. Also add a follow-up to run quarterly PD failover drills.
 ops-lead: Thanks team. Assigning postmortem owner: @nina_k. Expected draft by EOD tomorrow.
 pagerduty-bot: Final note: PD incident resolved at 23:12 UTC.
 alex.chang: Closing thread. If anyone notices residual undelivered alerts, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
